results.question: 比较家具类目与其他品类的差评率，并列出各品类差评数和评价总数
results.sql:
SELECT t.product_name_english AS category, SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_score <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_score <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS bad_pct
FROM olist_order_reviews_dataset r
JOIN olist_order_items_dataset oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN olist_products_dataset p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
GROUP BY t.product_name_english
ORDER BY bad_pct DESC
results.gold_sql: SELECT t.product_name_english AS category, SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_score <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.review_score <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS bad_pct FROM olist_order_reviews_dataset r JOIN olist_order_items_dataset oi ON r.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN olist_products_dataset p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name GROUP BY t.product_name_english ORDER BY bad_pct DESC

results.question: Chinook 各音乐流派每首歌带来的收入是多少？列出收入、曲目数和效率前五
results.sql:
SELECT g.Name AS genre, COUNT(DISTINCT t.TrackId) AS tracks, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) / COUNT(DISTINCT t.TrackId), 2) AS revenue_per_track
FROM chinook.Genre g
JOIN chinook.Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
JOIN chinook.InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
GROUP BY g.Name
ORDER BY revenue_per_track DESC
LIMIT 5
results.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name AS genre, COUNT(DISTINCT t.TrackId) AS tracks, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) / COUNT(DISTINCT t.TrackId), 2) AS revenue_per_track FROM chinook.Genre g JOIN chinook.Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId JOIN chinook.InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY revenue_per_track DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: 找出发货超期比例最高的 5 个商家，展示超期数、总订单项和比例
results.sql:
SELECT s.seller_id, s.seller_state, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_carrier_date > oi.shipping_limit_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_carrier_date > oi.shipping_limit_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS late_pct
FROM olist_order_items_dataset oi
JOIN olist_sellers_dataset s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
JOIN olist_orders_dataset o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.seller_id, s.seller_state
ORDER BY late_pct DESC
LIMIT 5
results.gold_sql: SELECT s.seller_id, s.seller_state, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_carrier_date > oi.shipping_limit_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late, COUNT(*) AS total, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_carrier_date > oi.shipping_limit_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS late_pct FROM olist_order_items_dataset oi JOIN olist_sellers_dataset s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id JOIN olist_orders_dataset o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.seller_id, s.seller_state ORDER BY late_pct DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: 拆解各音乐流派的收入驱动：歌曲数、平均价格与总收入，取前五
results.sql:
SELECT g.Name AS genre, COUNT(DISTINCT t.TrackId) AS tracks, ROUND(AVG(il.UnitPrice), 2) AS avg_price, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue
FROM chinook.Genre g
JOIN chinook.Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
JOIN chinook.InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
GROUP BY g.Name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5
results.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name AS genre, COUNT(DISTINCT t.TrackId) AS tracks, ROUND(AVG(il.UnitPrice), 2) AS avg_price, ROUND(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 2) AS revenue FROM chinook.Genre g JOIN chinook.Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId JOIN chinook.InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5
